messages:
mike: Heads-up — saw a sharp uptick in NVIDIA Xid 13 + 31 on prod-uswest2 GPU pool last night around 02:10. Bulk of hits tied to embedder jobs.
ops-bot: :warning: alert triggered: xid_13_rate > 15/min on prod-pool-uswest2 (nodes: gpu02-rack3, gpu14-rack8, gpu19-rack2)

sasha: Can you paste a sample kernel log and which workloads were running? embedder vs decode vs chat?
mike: quick paste from dmesg on gpu02-rack3:

[  125.432108] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 13, PID=16234, GPU=0: PID 0x3f2c5
[  125.432113] NVRM: GPU Memory: ...
[  125.432117] NVRM: ---

mike: Workloads: ~70% embedder (batching), small fraction streaming decode for chat fallback. Models: openembed-22B-int8 and search-encoder-v2-f16. Most failures during long sequences or big batches (seq>1024 or batch>256).

lee: Xid 13 frequently points to tiling/illegal memory access sometimes triggered by kernel/driver/memory path. Xid 31 pops up on ECC parity. Did we roll a driver or kernel on that fleet recently?

ben: We did a staged driver bump on 03/01 -> 535.19.03 on us-west2; some nodes still on 525.xx. Could be mixed-version interaction with MIG/PCIe.

anya: I ran a quick correlation across logs — grouping by xid code + tenant + op_type. Command I used:

awk '/Xid/ {print $0}' /var/log/kern.log | jq -R -s -c 'split("\n")' | python3 xid_agg.py --by tenant,op

anya: Summary: Xid13 concentrated on tenant=search-service and op_type=embed_batch; Xid31 more distributed and often on nodes with ECC corrected counts > 0. Attach: small CSV snippet (counts by node).

mike: Interesting — also noticed PCIe link speed drops right before some Xid13 events on gpu14-rack8. dmesg shows multiple "PCIe Bus Error" messages followed by Xid 13.
sasha: Could be physical card/slot or riser issue then. Let's validate by checking pciegen, linkwidth, and perfmon counters.

lee: Proposed immediate actions:
- cordon + drain nodes with >5 Xid13 in last 24h (gpu02-rack3, gpu14-rack8)
- run memtest/gpu-burn on drained cards (stress --gpu --seq-len 2048)
- capture nvidia-smi -q, pmon, lspci -vv, dmesg

mike: I'll start drain for gpu02-rack3 now. Pls assign rotation if tests fail.

ops-bot: drain started for gpu02-rack3 by mike. ETA 12m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

anya: Quick runbook I pushed to the ops-runbooks repo:
1) cordon node
2) kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
3) run: sudo nvidia-smi --query-gpu=ecc.errors.volatile --format=csv
4) run memtest (gpu-memtest --duration 2h)
5) if pci errors + memtest fail -> schedule RMA

ben: Small note on config — embedder int8 profile is using cudnn conv heuristics + continuous batching. If hardware is flaky, int8 quantized kernels can surface illegal memory access more aggressively. Consider routing heavy embed batches to float16 pool as short mitigation.

sasha: Agreed. For now: 1) drain flagged nodes, 2) route search-service traffic to f16-embed-pool (auto-fallthrough), 3) enable ECC counters collection and pcie stats for 72h.

lee: I'll create rotation tickets for the two suspect cards and tag hw-ops for onsite checks. If memtest passes but pcie errors persist -> reseat riser and retest.

mike: After drain+reboot+memtest on gpu02-rack3: memtest failed with single-bit ECC spikes, and PCIe Gen drop observed. Marking for RMA. :thumbsup:

anya: I added a lightweight parser to our observability pipeline to emit Xid code histograms by tenant/op_type — should help catch regressions. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/obs/pulls/342 :eyes:

oncall-bot: follow-up scheduled: hw-ops on-site check for gpu14-rack8 on 2024-03-05 09:00 PST. Ticket #HW-4921

sasha: Great. Let's reconvene after hardware rotation and 24h of new telemetry. If Xid13 persists across different HW + driver versions, escalate to NVIDIA with collected logs.

ben: Temporary routing change applied for search-service -> embed-f16-pool. Monitoring latency/cost impact.

mike: Thanks all. I'll post final RMA results and reenable initial pool once green. :white_check_mark:
